description.en: The description of the security group.
The ID of the security group.

description.zh:
安全组名称。命名规则如下：

- 长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。
- 必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以 http://和https://开头。
- 可以包含数字、英文冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）。
description.en:
The name of the security group. The name of a bucket must meet the following requirements:

- The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length.

- The name must start with a letter but cannot start with http\:// or https\://.

- The name can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

descriptions.zh:
- API调用频率：100次/秒。
- 单用户调用频率：5次/秒。
descriptions.en:
- Rate limit: 100 requests per second.

- up to 5 times per second per user.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens modify-security-group-attribute --security-group-id sg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --security-group-name example --description testDescription --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ens ModifySecurityGroupAttribute --region cn-hangzhou --Description testDescription --SecurityGroupName example --SecurityGroupId 'sg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000'
